method: Each gold query re-derived from RAW tables only (raw_games and raw_games_details de-duplicated by GAME_ID / GAME_ID+PLAYER_ID, DNP = COMMENT present or no stats), runner-up checked at every LIMIT/most, wording read for alternative readings. Round 1 found 3 not SOUND; fixed and re-run; round 2 all 40 SOUND.
replaced_while_drafting: Fewest points allowed per game 2003-04: DET and SAS tie exactly (6,909) -> dropped (2020-21 points-allowed trap kept as Q19).
Highest score by one team in a game: CHI 2019 and DEN 2008 tie at 168 -> replaced by biggest margin of victory (Q12).
Team most threes in a 2018-19 game: too close to P6 Q14/Q36 (HOU 2018-19) -> replaced by fewest points in a regular-season game (Q14).
Best effective FG% 2018-19: same shape as P6 Q29 (true shooting) -> replaced by games started (Q29).
League triple-doubles 2016-17: same season as P1 Q30 -> moved to 2012-13 (Q27).
LeBron James' first game for Miami: preseason vs regular-season reading -> replaced by Chris Paul's first regular-season game for Houston (Q6).
Warriors players 2021-22: no DNP-only players, so the trap did not bite -> Cavaliers 2019-20 (Q18).
2021 playoffs game count overlapped the 2021 play-in question -> 2020 playoffs (Q23).
Seattle SuperSonics 2004-05 record: second copy of the snapshot trap -> dropped for New Orleans Hornets (Q40).

questions.question: Who is the Houston Rockets' general manager in the data?
questions.notes: One teams row per franchise (2019 snapshot); the question says "in the data".

questions.question: Which teams list Staples Center as their home arena in the data?
questions.notes: Two teams list the arena; a short list, not a tie problem.
questions.round1_issue: Asked without "in the data": the arena has since been renamed and the Clippers moved, so a real-world reading differs from the 2019 snapshot. Fixed by adding "in the data".

questions.question: How many rebounds did Kevin Love grab in his game on November 12, 2010?
questions.notes: One row for Kevin Love that day (31 points, 31 rebounds).

questions.question: Who were the Toronto Raptors' five starters on June 13, 2019?
questions.notes: Exactly five TOR rows that day carry a START_POSITION (C, F, F, G, G); start position exists only in raw_games_details/src_games_details.

questions.question: When was Karl-Anthony Towns born, according to the data?
questions.notes: Player information covers only 2016-17 and lists him once; raw text "NOV 15, 1995".

questions.question: On what date did Chris Paul play his first regular-season game for the Houston Rockets?
questions.notes: He played (not DNP) on opening night 2017-10-17; earliest preseason HOU game is not regular season.

questions.notes: Runner-up Amir Johnson 271: no tie.

questions.question: How many players averaged at least 25 points per game in the 2019-20 regular season, among those who played at least 40 games?
questions.notes: Nobody sits between 24.0 and 25.0 PPG with 40+ games, so the threshold is not knife-edge; KAT (26.5 PPG, 35 games) is excluded by the stated 40-game floor.
questions.trap: games played must leave out DNP rows: dividing by box-score rows gives 10 (not 12); fct_player_performance (every game type, DNP rows as games) gives 6

questions.notes: Runner-up TOR 24: no tie.

questions.question: What was the league-wide free-throw percentage in the 2008-09 regular season? Give it as a fraction rounded to three decimals.
questions.notes: Totals ratio 0.77075; averaging per-game team FT_PCT is not the league percentage.

questions.question: Which month of the 2018-19 regular season had the most games?
questions.notes: March 2019 has 224 games, January 221: no tie.

questions.question: What was the biggest margin of victory in any game in the data? Give the winner, the loser, the date and the margin.
questions.notes: Next biggest margin is 68: no tie.

questions.notes: "In the data" counts every game type (188 in the regular season alone); 2003 preseason box scores are missing, which is the data as it is.

questions.question: What is the fewest points a team scored in a regular-season game in the data? Give the team, the opponent, the date and the points.
questions.notes: Next lowest is 56 (three teams): no tie at 54.

questions.notes: Count of player totals >= 1,000 in regular season.

questions.notes: Runner-up LeBron James and Allen Iverson 49: no tie.

questions.trap: the fct_ and int_ tables hold only seasons 2009 to 2019 and every game type: they give 2012 (1,674); local_player_season_facts counts every game type (2006 with 2,076)
questions.round1_issue: Asked without "in the data": Duncan's real career-best scoring season (2001-02) is before the data starts in 2003. Fixed by asking for the best regular season in the data.
